community_list_entries.name: Grounding Agent Memory in Contextual Intent

phase1_classification.kind_reason: The paper proposes STITCH (method) and also introduces CAME-Bench: 14 long synthetic goal-oriented trajectories (travel-planning user-assistant dialogue and two-agent debate, 23k to 408k tokens) with 373 questions. Question types are Incremental Memory Revision (entity state changes), Context-Aware
